issues.detail: The Greek 'βλεπωσιν την ασχημοσυνην αυτου' (they see his/its shame) is translated as 'người ta thấy sự xấu hổ mình' (people see my/one's shame). The Vietnamese pronoun 'mình' refers back to the 'kẻ tỉnh thức' (the watchful one), whereas the Greek 'αυτου' (his/its) refers back to the 'κλεπτης' (thief).
